calculation.description: Negative-direction risk-normalized 10-day return, with a 50% magnitude boost when recent five-day average volume expansion or contraction agrees in sign with the return. If volume is unavailable or zero, the multiplier defaults to 1. The persisted direction is inverse to the raw signal because inverse values predicted subsequent returns better.

gate.note: The reported IC and ICIR are 20-trading-day forward-return cross-sectional paper metrics; the inverse direction is used for admission. Deterministic downstream signal-artifact correlation audit remains required.

validation.regime_notes: The raw signal was negative in 2025-2027 (IC -0.043879, ICIR -0.164374) and 2028-2030-03-06 (IC -0.017461, ICIR -0.056605); the inverse direction was positive in both regimes, though weaker recently than the full-sample result. No qualifying 2020-2024 observations were available under the aligned data intersection for this volume-dependent candidate. Use conservative ensemble weight and revalidate promptly.
